entities.name: River Nish
entities.description: Flooding river in Tamingazin, Otaria, with roiling green waters home to attalo.

entities.name: Magewall
entities.description: Wall crossing the River Nish that imposes magical slow-time.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: City that executes prisoners by throwing them in the river.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Brainwashed wizard who escaped down the River Nish.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suderbod ambassador who escaped down the River Nish.

events.summary: After King Tagard Tarngold's assassination, Aligarius Timni and Ursal Daleel escaped by sailing down the River Nish and crossing the magewall.
events.quote: After the assassination of King Tagard Tarngold , the brainwashed wizard Aligarius Timni and the Suderbod ambassador Ursal Daleel escaped by sailing down the River Nish and crossing the magewall while on the ship.
